notes:
Movies and episodes keep playing in the small picture when you back out of full screen, as live TV does. On Home, Movies and Shows it sits under the banner with Pause, Stop and Full screen, and on Live TV, Sports and Search it sits at the top. Full screen picks up where it is instead of starting over, and Stop ends it.

Subtitles and captions are now white text with a black outline and no box behind them. Settings > Playback and audio > Subtitles and captions changes the text size, colour, background, edge, font and position, with a preview, or follows Android's own caption style.

Phones: the picture and Now playing sit under the banner on Home, Movies and Shows, as on tablets.

Sports: a followed team's next game is found even when ESPN's team schedule has already moved on to next season. Inter Miami's MLS playoff game on November 27 was missing, with February shown as the next game.
